title: Tringify section schema
markdownDescription:
The `{% schema %}` of a section or theme block.

[Documentation](https://dev-docs.tringify.com/themes/section-schema)

name.markdownDescription: The section's name, unique in the theme. A theme block's name matches its file name.

markdownEnumDescriptions: A section merchants place on a page (default).
A section for a global surface such as the header or footer. Declares a `target`.
A section for the overlay layer, such as a cart drawer or popup. Declares a `target`.
A theme block in `blocks/`. No `target` and no presets.
Opening of `<body>`, before the page template: announcement bar, header.
End of `<body>`, after the page template: footer.
Overlay layer: cart drawer, localization prompt, popups.
target.markdownDescription:
The global surface a `layout` or `embed` section renders in.

[Documentation](https://dev-docs.tringify.com/themes/templates-and-surfaces#global-surfaces)

icon.description: The icon shown for the section in the editor.

ctx_needs.markdownDescription:
The store data the section reads. Declare a root such as `product`, or a dotted need such as `cart.item_count`. A section can read only what it declares.

[Documentation](https://dev-docs.tringify.com/ctx/runtime-context)

items.errorMessage: Unknown CTX name. A ctx_needs entry is a CTX root, such as product or cart, optionally followed by a field: cart.item_count.

defaultSnippets.label: auth_form
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: Safe hosted-auth form replay state after a submission. Present after a hosted form submission.

defaultSnippets.label: auth_notice
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: A localized sign-in or registration status message. Present after a hosted form submission.

defaultSnippets.label: blog
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: The routed blog landing page and paginated article cards. Provided on `blog` pages.

defaultSnippets.label: blog_category
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: The routed blog category metadata. The blog root carries its paginated article cards. Provided on `blog_category` pages.

defaultSnippets.label: blog_post
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: The routed blog article, author, categories, comments, and comment pagination. Provided on `blog_post` pages.

defaultSnippets.label: blog_recent
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: A bounded route-free list of recent published article cards. Requested data, available on normal storefront pages.

defaultSnippets.label: brand
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: The routed brand metadata and storefront-visible metafields. Provided on `brand` pages.

defaultSnippets.label: breadcrumbs
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: The platform-resolved entity trail. Themes may prepend their localized Home link. Provided on its pages.

defaultSnippets.label: cart
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: The current cart. Header use receives counts; rich cart surfaces receive line, price, discount, limit, and shipping data. Requested data, available on normal storefront pages.

defaultSnippets.label: category
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: The routed category metadata and storefront-visible metafields. Provided on `category` pages.

defaultSnippets.label: collection
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: The routed collection metadata and storefront-visible metafields. Provided on `collection` pages.

defaultSnippets.label: consent
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: Visitor consent state. available_categories lists the optional cookie categories the consent banner offers, in display order; categories lists the ones the visitor has granted. Available on every page.

defaultSnippets.label: csrf_token
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: The signed form nonce for hosted storefront mutations. Available on every page.

defaultSnippets.label: customer
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: The signed-in shopper and, when requested, their account addresses, orders, and routed receipt. Requested; provided on `account` pages.

defaultSnippets.label: customer_settings
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: Storefront-safe account, sign-in, registration, consent, and customer feature settings. Requested data, available on normal storefront pages.

defaultSnippets.label: filters
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: Platform-resolved filters and active filter state for the current product listing. Provided on `shop`, `search`, `collection`, `category`, `vendor`, `brand` pages.

defaultSnippets.label: form_error
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: A localized validation error returned by a hosted form. Present after a hosted form submission.

defaultSnippets.label: form_notice
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: A localized post-redirect result from a hosted storefront action. Present after a hosted form submission.

defaultSnippets.label: forms
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: Hosted-action field requirements and length or media limits. Requested data, available on normal storefront pages.

defaultSnippets.label: list
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: The generic vendor, brand, collection, or category index for the routed list page. Provided on `vendor_list`, `brand_list`, `collection_list`, `category_list` pages.

defaultSnippets.label: localization
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: Current locale and the country and language choices enabled for this storefront. Available on every page.

defaultSnippets.label: localization_prompt
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: The platform decision for whether to offer a country or language change to this visitor. Available on every page.

defaultSnippets.label: menus
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: Available navigation menus keyed by handle. Resource picker settings resolve a selected menu to its full item tree. Available on every page.

defaultSnippets.label: page
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: The routed published content page. Provided on `page` pages.

defaultSnippets.label: pages
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: Bounded route-free index of published content pages for navigation surfaces. Requested data, available on normal storefront pages.

defaultSnippets.label: phone_countries
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: Localized phone country options allowed by the store's customer settings. Requested data, available on normal storefront pages.

defaultSnippets.label: policies
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: Route-free index of published store policies for legal navigation. Requested data, available on normal storefront pages.

defaultSnippets.label: policy
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: The routed published store policy. Provided on `policy` pages.

defaultSnippets.label: product
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: The routed product with variants, options, pricing, availability, session state, and storefront-visible metafields. Provided on `product` pages.

defaultSnippets.label: products
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: A routed product grid with platform search, sort, and pagination state. Provided on `shop`, `search`, `collection`, `category`, `vendor`, `brand` pages.

defaultSnippets.label: recently_viewed
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: Visibility-gated product cards recently viewed on this device. Requested data, available on normal storefront pages.

defaultSnippets.label: restock_notifications
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: Availability and channel rules for a product restock request form. Requested data, available on normal storefront pages.

defaultSnippets.label: review_notice
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: Legacy alias of form_notice retained for installed theme compatibility. Present after a hosted form submission.

defaultSnippets.label: reviews
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: Product review availability, aggregates, filters, and approved review rows. Requested; provided on `product` pages.

defaultSnippets.label: routes
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: Canonical storefront URLs using the store's locale, country, and permalink configuration. Available on every page.

defaultSnippets.label: search
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: The search query, grouped result totals, and canonical result projections. Provided on `search` pages.

defaultSnippets.label: shop
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: Store identity, storefront-visible store metafields, and the active market's standing free-shipping offer. Available on every page.

defaultSnippets.label: store_reviews
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: Store-wide approved reviews with product links and pagination. Requested data, available on normal storefront pages.

defaultSnippets.label: vendor
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: The routed vendor metadata and storefront-visible metafields. Provided on `vendor` pages.

defaultSnippets.label: wishlist
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: The visitor's wishlist state and, for rich surfaces, its sellable product rows. Requested data, available on normal storefront pages.

presets.markdownDescription:
Ready-made versions of the section offered when a merchant adds one.

[Documentation](https://dev-docs.tringify.com/themes/section-schema#presets)

id.markdownDescription: Unique in the section. The template reads `settings.<id>`.

markdownEnumDescriptions: Search and pick one blog category. The template reads the item, or nothing if it was deleted.
Search and pick one blog post. The template reads the item, or nothing if it was deleted.
Search and pick one brand. The template reads the item, or nothing if it was deleted.
Search and pick one category. The template reads the item, or nothing if it was deleted.
Toggle. The template reads `true` or `false`.
Search and pick one collection. The template reads the item, or nothing if it was deleted.
Pick and order several collections, up to `max`. The template reads a list of the picked items.
Colour picker. The template reads a hex colour.
One of the theme's colour schemes. The template reads the scheme's id.
Image from the media library. The template reads an image URL; use `image_url`.
Menu picker. The template reads the menu from `settings.<id>_resolved`.
Number input. The template reads a number.
A group of the declared `fields`. The template reads an object of field values.
Search and pick one page. The template reads the item, or nothing if it was deleted.
Search and pick one policy. The template reads the item, or nothing if it was deleted.
Search and pick one product. The template reads the item, or nothing if it was deleted.
Pick and order several products, up to `max`. The template reads a list of the picked items.
Slider. Needs `min` and `max`; `step` and `unit` are optional. The template reads a number.
Rich text editor. The template reads formatted HTML, cleaned of anything unsafe.
Drop-down. Needs `options`. The template reads the chosen option's `value`.
Single-line text. The template reads text.
Multi-line text. The template reads text.
Link. The template reads a URL.
Code editor. The template reads the rendered output of the merchant's Vascula code.
Search and pick one vendor. The template reads the item, or nothing if it was deleted.
Video from the media library. The template reads a video URL.
type.markdownDescription:
The setting type, which decides the editor control.

[Documentation](https://dev-docs.tringify.com/themes/section-schema#setting-types)

default.description: The value a new section starts with.

editor.markdownDescription: `label` and optional `group`. A setting without `editor` is not shown to merchants. Both can be literal text or keys from `locales/<locale>.schema.json` (`fieldLabel.<label>`, `fieldGroup.<group>`).

label.description: The setting's label in the theme editor.

group.description: The editor group the setting appears in.

fields.markdownDescription: For `object`: the fields of the value, each with a unique `key`.

max.markdownDescription: For `range` (required) and `number`: the highest value. For `product_list` and `collection_list`: the most items (12 if not set).

unit.markdownDescription: For `range`: the unit shown after the value, such as `px`.

visible_if.markdownDescription: Show the setting only when another setting has one of the given values.

setting.description: The id of the other setting.

values.description: The values that show this setting.

key.description: The field's key in the object value.

default.description: The value a new section starts with.

editor.markdownDescription: `label` and optional `group`. A setting without `editor` is not shown to merchants. Both can be literal text or keys from `locales/<locale>.schema.json` (`fieldLabel.<label>`, `fieldGroup.<group>`).

types.description: The block types this section defines.

default.description: The blocks a newly added section starts with. Every type must be declared.

max.description: The most blocks a merchant can add. Omit for no limit.

accept_theme_blocks.markdownDescription:
Accept the theme's shared theme blocks (`blocks/<name>.vasc`), stored as `theme:<name>`. Place `{% blocks %}` where they render. Blocks nest up to 4 levels.

[Documentation](https://dev-docs.tringify.com/themes/theme-blocks)

accept_app_blocks.description: Accept blocks from the merchant's installed apps.

type.description: The block type. Unique in the section.

label.description: The block's name in the theme editor.

name.description: The preset's name in the editor's "Add section" list.

category.description: The category the preset is listed under.

blocks.description: Starting blocks: declared block types, or theme:<name> when the section accepts theme blocks.
